question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Nvidia guided Q3 FY27 revenue to $108.0B ±2% (Aug 26, 2026). Over the last ~7 quarters actual revenue has beaten the midpoint by ~2.5-8%, most recently +4.6% (Q1 FY27 $81.6B) and +5.7% (Q2 FY27 $96.2B vs $91.0B). Applying a ~4-5% beat gives a median near $112.6B. Sell-side consensus sits around $109-111B. Supply-chain data (Taiwan September revenue at a record high, Vera Rubin ramp) supports a normal-to-strong beat. Manifold (thin) puts 8% <110, 40% 110-112, 26% 112-114, 17% 114-116, 10% >=116; I sit slightly above it. Upper escape (>116B, a beat of >7.4%) priced at 11%; lower escape (<105B, a miss below the guide range) at 2%.
